messages:
alex: Heads up — prepping cut for rc-2026. Need final approval on PR #4321 (model routing change). Tests pass locally, e2e flaky. Can someone triage? cc @release-team :eyes:
release-bot: CI update — PR #4321: 3 checks running, 1 failed (integration/flaky-timeout). https://ci.redwood.example/build/98765
morgan: I'll grab it in ~30m. If it's just a timeout we can retry.
sam: quick note — add a changelog entry (under 'Runtime: routing') and mark for backport to v1.x if we accept.
alex: changelog slot added at docs/changelog/unreleased.md line 42. Backport needed for v1.2.3
priya: Canary plan? I'd prefer a 5% traffic canary on Dedicated for 24h before full cut. We can use the rollout policy `canary-5pct-24h`.
morgan: quick repro steps? I hit the integration timeout on `runtime-routing-spec` locally with `pytest tests/integration/test_routing.py -k kv_cache` — logs below:
```
E       TimeoutError: request timed out after 30s
...stack...
```
alex: thanks, pasted failing test excerpt above — looks like a race in cache priming. I'm rerunning CI with increased timeout: `CI_TIMEOUT=60 yarn test:ci`
release-bot: CI update — PR #4321: retry triggered by alex — queue position 2
sam: I can write the backport PR once this merges. Ping me with the merged SHA and target branch v1.x.
morgan: LGTM with single nit (naming). Filed comment on line 88. Once CI green i'll approve + merge.
alex: @morgan appreciated. If you can approve after CI is green, I'll handle the backport and changelog release note. :rocket:
priya: +1 for canary. Also set `max_tokens=2048` in the canary config to match infra.
morgan: CI passed. Approved. Merging now.
release-bot: PR #4321 merged by morgan. Build artifact: s3://redwood-artifacts/4321/rc-2026. Notifying release channel.
alex: thanks everyone. Follow-up task — sam please open backport PR and tag security for review if any dependency bumped.
